stories.title: Researchers used Claude to hack OpenAI
stories.details: Independent researchers at Hacktron AI used Anthropic's Claude to chain two flaws and access employee ChatGPT accounts, earning a $6,500 bug-bounty payout. The incident highlighted the accelerating speed of AI-assisted hacking, as the model successfully built an exploit that previous versions could not.

stories.title: Google says its Gemini AI model hacked three other companies
stories.details: Google has reported that its Gemini AI model successfully compromised three separate companies. This development raises significant concerns regarding the security risks posed by advanced AI systems.

stories.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping 'theft'
stories.details: Unsealed court filings reveal that a top Microsoft director privately labeled AI training practices as 'the largest theft of labor in human history.' Internal data showed that the Copilot engine significantly reduced traffic to news sites, while OpenAI allegedly bypassed paywalls to scrape content.

stories.title: Salesforce staggers back to feet after global outage
stories.details: Salesforce experienced a major global outage during its annual conference in San Francisco, causing severe delays and intermittent errors for customers. The company struggled to restore services while thousands of attendees were present at the event.

stories.title: Oracle celebrates banner quarter with another round of layoffs
stories.details: Despite reporting a successful financial quarter driven by its AI cloud boom, Oracle has initiated a new round of layoffs. The move has drawn criticism for cutting staff immediately after achieving significant growth.

stories.title: SpaceX eyes dead startups' data for AI training
stories.details: SpaceX is reportedly in informal talks to purchase customer and operational data from struggling or failed startups. The company intends to use this data to train its xAI Grok models, aiming to compete with major industry players.

stories.title: US and Denmark reach security deal after Trump’s threats to take over Greenland
stories.details: The US and Denmark have finalized a security agreement following previous tensions sparked by Donald Trump's threats to acquire Greenland. The deal aims to stabilize the relationship between the two nations regarding the territory.

stories.title: AI titans invited to Trump-Xi dinner
stories.details: Top technology and AI leaders have been invited to a dinner coinciding with the upcoming summit between President Trump and China's Xi Jinping. The meeting is expected to touch upon industry regulations and potential chip sales to China.

stories.title: The hidden human cost of Kim Jong-un’s new power
stories.details: North Korea's financial and diplomatic leverage is reportedly built on the brutal exploitation of its citizens. Reports indicate that the regime relies on forced labor from coal miners and diplomats both domestically and abroad to sustain its power.

stories.title: Burning forests, emptying rivers: Europe’s politicians face reckoning
stories.details: European politicians are facing a political reckoning following a 'summer of truth' characterized by extreme environmental damage. The continent has seen over €180 billion in losses due to wildfires and drought, forcing a re-evaluation of climate policies.

stories.title: This Israeli election could be the country’s last
stories.details: Commentator Jonathan Freedland warns that the current Israeli election cycle may be the country's last, citing deep internal divisions. The analysis reflects on the extreme political volatility currently gripping the nation.

stories.title: Alexander-Arnold recalled by England but with a warning from Tuchel
stories.details: Trent Alexander-Arnold has been recalled to the England squad by manager Thomas Tuchel. However, the manager has issued a warning to the player regarding his performance expectations for the upcoming international fixtures.

stories.title: Spying some tasty match-ups, from Wrexham v Saints to desperation derbies
stories.details: The weekend features a series of high-stakes derby matches, including Wrexham versus Southampton and various clashes in the Championship. Clubs are dealing with intense pressure as they navigate these rivalries amidst ongoing league campaigns.

stories.title: We wanted to let Dowman bloom in the shadows but he has become hard to ignore
stories.details: Barney Ronay discusses the emergence of young talent Dowman, who has become impossible to overlook despite efforts to develop him quietly. His recent performances have forced him into the spotlight of the footballing world.

stories.title: Gianni Infantino presents his big idea for peace through Qatar 2022
stories.details: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has called for a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine during the Qatar World Cup. The proposal has been met with skepticism from critics who point to his previous comments urging nations to focus solely on football.

stories.title: Ashton United offers to take Erling Haaland on loan
stories.details: Ashton United of the Northern Premier League has humorously offered to take Manchester City's Erling Haaland on loan during the World Cup break. The club argues it would help the striker stay fit while his team is not playing.

stories.title: A dementia expert on what HRT really does to the brain
stories.details: A major new study has explored the link between Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT) and Alzheimer’s rates. While the study uncovers a surprising connection, experts note that the evidence remains inconclusive.

stories.title: A prominent psychologist set out to research the benefits of meditation
stories.details: A researcher who began a study on the benefits of meditation found results that were unexpectedly alarming. The findings have prompted a deeper look into the potential psychological risks associated with certain meditative practices.

stories.title: Where is Sir Ranulph Fiennes?
stories.details: The world’s greatest living explorer, Sir Ranulph Fiennes, has become a subject of concern at age 82. Despite his history of surviving extreme conditions, his current whereabouts remain unknown to those closest to him.

stories.title: The death of Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie’s child changed her view of Nigeria
stories.details: Author Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie reflects on how the tragic loss of her child fundamentally altered her perspective on her home country. The personal experience has influenced her outlook on Nigerian society and politics.

stories.title: Faster! Louder! Brighter! How the attention economy overwhelmed children’s TV
stories.details: An analysis of the modern attention economy explores how children's television has become increasingly aggressive in its pacing and style. The report examines the impact of these changes on young viewers.
